traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): succulent subshrubs (perennial).

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): subshrubs, succulent; C. edulis has a persistent leathery bark.

traits.stem_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems trailing, mat-forming, rooting at the nodes; flowering branches ascending.

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems root at the nodes; species naturalize vegetatively and from seed.

traits.stem_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems trailing, 5-30 dm.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves cauline, opposite, slightly joined at the base, those of a pair equal.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): opposite pairs; crossing pairs assumed as in the family's opposite-leaved mesembs (family file decussate usually).

traits.stipules.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stipules absent.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves sessile.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): glabrous.

traits.stem_hairs.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): glabrous.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade margins entire or dentate (C. edulis: outer angle serrate near the apex).

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers solitary.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal or axillary.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pedicel (absent or 1-)10-60(-100) mm, erect.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers showy, 3-10(-15) cm across.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): petals (including petaloid staminodes) to 250, distinct, linear, spreading many-rowed: a flat, daisy-like flower (Wikipedia: 'large daisy-like flowers'). FNA calls the flower tubular for its hypanthium.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): pistil 8-12(-25)-carpellate; stigmas 8-12(-25), radiate.

traits.ovary_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): ovary inferior.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (2003), Carpobrotus (Vivrette) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): fruits berries, fleshy, edible, indehiscent.
